crop.notes: Headline and decks ('A WET BLANKET. Unpropitious Elements Caused Postponement of the Parade...') at top of column are not in the clipping; the Allen paragraph is complete. Clipping ends in the start of 'The Military Ball' section.

ocr.notes: Gist readable; many character errors, including in the Allen paragraph ('Hity ihehts in frent of his sa-loon').

title.suggested: Tom Allen struggles to light the Fair Week illumination at his saloon

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that, after rain postponed the Fair Week trades parade and illuminations, ex-champion Tom Allen spent nearly an hour with a twelve-foot torch trying to light some fifty gas jets in front of his saloon, without success.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Friday Morning, October 5, 1883. The incident took place the evening of Thursday, October 4.

notes: One paragraph about Allen inside a long weather/parade story; anecdote only, no biography-level facts.
